thread:
mike (AE): FYI inbound SIG/CAIQ from HelixCare — they attached CAIQ v3 and a short questionnaire. Theyre asking for completed CAIQ + SOC2 excerpts before POC kickoff. Doc: https://files.redwood/helixcare/caiaq-v3.pdf

security-bot: Intake created: SR-8012. Queue: security-review.

tara (sales-ops): pinging security for ownership. POC kickoff is planned in 6 business days. We need a short controls summary for the customer and any red flags asap.

nina (security): I'll own this. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Will POC process PHI or other regulated data? 2) Are they requiring customer-managed keys during POC? Those change evidence needs.

mike (AE): POC will use synthetic data only. Theyre asking about PHI support for production. Also asked if we can provide pen-test summary or public vuln disclosure timeline.

omar (solutions): For production PHI we recommend Private deployment (VPC or on-prem). We have HIPAA guide. Pen testing: we provide a redacted pen-test summary and our bug bounty program details.

lee (legal): Customer asked for SOC2 before POC. We usually require signed NDA before sharing SOC2. Has NDA been sent?

mike (AE): Sent mutual NDA this morning. Waiting on signature.

security-bot: SR-8012 status -> assigned to nina (security).

nina (security): Starting CAIQ fill. Plan: 1) quick mapping for high/med/low controls 2) attach SOC2 pointer if NDA present 3) flag any items needing architecture changes. ETA 48h.

tara (sales-ops): If any item blocks POC timeline, call it out here so we can set expectations with HelixCare.

nina (security): Noted. Early review: data-in-transit and restful auth ok. Key management entries: we list BYOK via Private + dedicated KMS integrations. For hosted we only support envelope encryption; we can rotate keys quarterly.

omar (solutions): Confirmed: AWS KMS & GCP KMS supported for Private. HSM via partner ISV and requires ent. onboarding. For hosted, we can support Bring Your Own Key via customer subscription but not for trial POC.

lee (legal): Please don't share SOC2 until NDA executed. If they insist, offer a redacted summary first.

mike (AE): Customer asked if we support on-prem air-gapped deployments. Theyre in a regulated environment and want it on the table.

nina (security): Air-gapped on-prem is possible but requires infra engagement and longer lead time — note as production-only, not for POC.

security-bot: Evidence uploaded placeholder -> redwood-soc2-summary-redacted.pdf (pending access)

nina (security): Uploaded CAIQ draft to intake folder: https://files.redwood/helixcare/caiaq-draft-v1.xlsx. Annotated 6 controls as "requires follow-up" (KMS, HSM, HLR retention, third-party subproc details).

tara (sales-ops): Thanks. Can we get a 1-paragraph customer summary for the POC that sales can send orally during kickoff?

nina (security): Draft summary: "For POC using synthetic data, no high-severity security blockers detected. Production deployment for PHI recommended on Private or on-prem with customer KMS/HSM options; BYOK for POC requires ent ops (+10 business days). SOC2 redacted summary available once NDA is signed."

mike (AE): Perfect. I'll relay that in kickoff and push NDA signature.

lee (legal): NDA signed now. Mike, share the signer details and Ill release the redacted SOC2.

mike (AE): Shared signer info via DM.

security-bot: SR-8012 status updated -> "ready for customer" (CAIQ draft + SOC2 summary available)

nina (security): Marking SR-8012 as ready for customer. Action items: 1) sales confirm synthetic-only POC on kickoff 2) note BYOK production lead time if they request it in POC.

tara (sales-ops): Recorded SR-8012 outcome in CRM and attached intake notes.

mike (AE): Thanks team 1 :tada:
